name: The Red Hill Baker
signature: Artisan bread, pies and pastries from the bakery's sole current shop in Balnarring.
editorNote: The Red Hill Baker no longer operates in Red Hill. Its official website lists Balnarring as its sole location, open daily from 6am to 4pm. The bakery remains useful for bread, pies and pastries, but it must be planned as a Balnarring stop rather than a Red Hill village stop.
whyWeGo: A reliable early Balnarring stop for bread, pies and pastries.
ifOnlyOneThing: Go early for the fullest bread and pastry selection.

heroImage.depicts: an illustrative arrangement of rustic loaves

closureNote: The former Red Hill location is closed. The business now operates only from Balnarring, as confirmed by the operator website on 2026-09-29.
